test_objective: Check that you cannot get an entity with invalid id

test_cases.name: 018_02_01 Get an entity if the Entity Id is not a valid URI
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot get an entity with invalid/missing id
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entity Request: and
    Query Parameter: id set to 'thisisaninvaliduri' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/ld+json'
}
